title: Implement UserController for user management with role gating
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/users lists users (Owner sees all, Admin sees non-owner)
POST /api/v1/users creates a user (Admin cannot create Owner)
Kasir cannot access user management endpoints
completion_summary: UserController CRUD + UserRequest; owner sees all, admin non-owner; gate blocks admin managing owner; deactivate via is_active; password hash; 11 curl scenarios
